newsitem.title: USA: Texaco, ABB set gasification alliance.
newsitem.headline: Texaco, ABB set gasification alliance.

text.p: Texaco Inc said it and ABB Group have established an alliance aimed at capturing a signifcant share of the growing market for gasification technology and facilities in Europe.

Under terms of the alliance agreement, Texaco said, the two companies will seek out opportunities to develop, license, build, own and operate gasification projects, as well as provide services and equipment, in the European marketplace.
Primary sectors that are the focus of the alliance include power generation, refining and chemicals, Texaco said.
In addition, it said, the alliance will seek out opportunities to develop gasification projects to convert waste materials into syngas and electric power.
